post.description: Create a new product catalog. Represents a catalog for your business you can use to deliver ads with dynamic ads.

vertical.description: The type of catalog. Supported values: adoptable_pets, automotive_models, avatar, bookable, commerce, destinations, flights, home_listings, hotels, jobs, local_delivery_shipping_profiles, local_service_businesses, location_based_items, media_titles, offer_items, offline_commerce, test_vertical, ticketed_experiences, transactable_items, vehicle_offers, vehicles

name.description: The name of a catalog given by the creator

product_count.description: The total number of products in a catalog

feed_count.description: The total number of feeds used by a catalog

default_image_url.description: The URL for the default image, which is used for products without images, or when the product image is temporarily unavailable. If a product image matches the default image, this should be treated as if the image was not loaded

fallback_image_url.description: The URL for the fallback image. This is used as the image for auto-generated dynamic items

is_catalog_segment.description: Verify that you will create ads based on a catalog or catalog segment before you try to create Dynamic Ads. Call this field and determine value otherwise you may get and error when you try to create Dynamic Ads from catalog segments.

da_display_settings.description: Image display settings such as background cropping and padding of items in the catalog for different Dynamic Ad format

carousel_ad.description: Dynamic Ad display settings that would be applied to carousel ads

transformation_type.description: The type of image transformation that would be applied to the image in a dynamic ad. Supported values: background_cropping_and_padding, background_padding, none

single_ad.description: Dynamic Ad display settings that would be applied to single item ads.

transformation_type.description: The type of image transformation that would be applied to the image in a dynamic ad. Supported values: background_cropping_and_padding, background_padding, none

type.description: Type of campaign : API or BROADCAST

Current status of campaign
API Campaign : LIVE | STOPPED | PAUSED
Broadcast Campaign : SENDING | SENT | FAILED

id.description: Contact Id, used for uniquely identifying a Contact on AiSensy

is_closed.description: Closed status of a Chat. True value represents that the chat has been closed.

is_intervened.description: Intervened status of chat. Represents if the chat of the Contact has been intervened by any Agent.

is_requesting.description: Represents if the Contact needs Agent intervention. If your chatbot doesn't able to answer Contact's query then the Chat automatically goes to Requesting Queue.

last_active.description: Timestamp(millis) of last message received from the Contact

name.description: Name of the Contact as on WhatsApp.

intervened_by.description: Id of the Agent who has intervened this chat

country_code.description: Country code of the Contact's WA number. It is used for Country specific WhatsApp billings.

on_whatsapp.description: It represents that the Contact's phone number exists on WhatsApp or not

last_message.description: Timestamp(millis) of last message exchanged. It could have been sent by the Contact or the Business

first_message.description: First message tags helps you the first intent of your Contact's query. It is automaticaaly assigned if tag's first message get's matched with Contact's first message to your Business. You can assign tags with active First Message Setting.

added_by.description: Id of the Agent who assigned the tag.

id.description: Message Id, used for uniquely identifying a Message on AiSensy

contact_id.description: Contact Id, used for uniquely identifying a Contact on AiSensy

campaign.description: Campain detail if message was sent via campaign

campaign_id.description: Campaign Id, used for uniquely identifying a campaign on AiSensy

mau_details.description: MAU detail if deductionType is MAU

session_period.description: Timestamp(millis) of the start date of current billing cycle

session_created_by.description: MAU deducted due to user or business

whatsapp_conversation_details.description: WhatsApp Conversation detail if deductionType is WA

type.description: MAU deducted due to user or business
